summary: Tested sign-up 'Type of business' and the Terms of Service vs PIPEDA/PHIPA routing. Backend: new test_signup_business_type.py passes 11/11. It covers: invalid or empty business_type returns 400; pharmacy without privacy_consent returns 400; law_office without terms_consent returns 400; store with privacy_consent only returns 400. Nothing is stored on those 400s. store, law_office, flower_shop and other store terms_consent, terms_version 2026-06 and terms_consent_at, with no phipa fields. Pharmacy stores phipa_consent_given, privacy_consent and consent_version. The admin list includes business_type and leaves out _id. In test_signup_review_requests.py, 18 pass and 13 fail. Every failure comes from the Resend 429 email rate limit (approve returns email_status 'failed: Email provider error 429', and review-request returns 424) or from tests that depend on those. These failures are external and pre-existing. Frontend at 390x844, no page errors: the 5 chips are 44px tall. signup-submit stays disabled until a type, business name, your name and email are all filled; clearing the email disables it again. Law office: label 'Review terms & send', hint text and signup-terms-link are shown, and submit opens terms-modal (not consent-modal). The checkbox is disabled until terms-scroll reaches the bottom, and terms-accept is enabled only after scrolling and ticking. This works by tapping either the row or the inner checkbox, with no double toggle. Success shows signup-done, and the DB doc is correct. Pharmacy: label 'Review privacy terms & send' and signup-privacy-link are shown; consent-modal mentions PIPEDA and PHIPA, both checkboxes are needed after scrolling, and it ends at signup-done. /terms shows all 11 sections, and Back returns to /sign-up with the form state kept. terms-full-link opens /terms. Admin /admin/signups shows 'PHARMACY · ACCEPTED PIPEDA/PHIPA TERMS' and 'LAW OFFICE · ACCEPTED TERMS OF SERVICE'. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: SignupIn.business_type defaults to 'store'. If business_type is missing, the request does not get the 400 'Choose a type of business'. It is treated as a store and fails with 'Please accept the Terms of Service' instead. Older native builds that send only privacy_consent now get this Terms error.

Approval carries only pharmacy consent over to the new user. For non-pharmacy shops, terms_consent and terms_version are not copied to the user or merchant, so that record lives only on the signup_request. business_type is not copied to the merchant either, and pharmacy sign-ups do not get pharmacy_partner set.

ui_bugs.issue: The read and agree state persists after Cancel. When the modal is reopened, Accept & Send is already enabled with the box ticked, so the user is not asked to accept again.

issues: The 'Accept & Continue' label wraps to 2 lines at 390px width (pre-existing).
The Pressable checkbox rows do not expose aria-checked on web: accessibilityState.checked is not mapped. Consider accessibilityRole='checkbox' together with aria-checked.

action_items: Optional: make business_type required in SignupIn (no default), or return a clearer error when it is missing.
Optional: on approve, copy terms_version, terms_consent_at and business_type to the merchant or user. Consider setting pharmacy_partner for pharmacy sign-ups.
Optional: reset TermsModal read and agree state when the modal closes.

Optional: admin/signups.tsx works out the 'ACCEPTED ...' label from business_type, not from the stored consent flags (phipa_consent_given / terms_consent). Use the flags so the label shows what was actually accepted.
critical_code_review_comments: TermsModal imports TERMS from '@/app/terms', a route file. Move the content to src/ (e.g. src/content/terms.ts) and import it from there in both places, so the component does not depend on a route module.
TERMS_VERSION '2026-06' is hardcoded in the backend, and TERMS_UPDATED 'June 2026' in the frontend. Keep them in one place, or check that they match.

success_rate.backend: 100% of feature tests (11/11); the legacy signup suite has 13 failures, all from Resend 429 (external)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ signup_requests (API and UI). All deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit is 5 inserted signups per IP per hour. Delete db.signup_requests store_name ^TEST_ before running. Validation 400s happen before the rate-limit check. The frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Resend 429 breaks the approve and review email tests.
